en: <You seem interested in science>
Well, now... I don't read all the time.
I'm very interested in modern science.
And teaching science to my pupils is a joy.
Yes, precisely.
Science holds tremendous possibilities.
Ah, if only I were a researcher, not a mere teacher!
(This could go on for a while...)
Oh, you seem to be in a hurry... What a pity.
Let's have a proper talk next time.
...Hm? You can't just walk in here like that.
The school grounds are off-limits to outsiders.
The truth is, I have a mind to study again.
If there is a good book on science, I would
have you recommend it to me.
Is that so! Most admirable. Splendid, indeed.
I'm Matthew, and I'm a teacher here.
You're welcome to read any of the books
you find here. They're all easy ones meant
for students, mind you.
Oh, but we've met before, haven't we?
Ideally, I would teach you in person.
note: Kept as a full sentence so #422 also stands alone (msg 14178).

en: Reading is a fine thing too, you know.
Good day,
note: Before the name (msg 13446: 'Good day, {NAME}.' with #98 '.'). Variant for Stanley's puzzled reply to the player's 'Good evening.' (+ '...?' from #265/#537).

en: Forgive me, I have lessons to prepare.
The truth is, I get little time to myself.
Hello.
Phew, so busy. A teacher's life isn't easy.
But this is the work I'm meant to do.
I manage to read on my way to and from work.
I can't neglect my pupils, after all.
Good day.
I'm too busy at school to be a proper host,
so please do call on me at home.
I'd love to be a researcher and study science.
But I can't leave my pupils behind...
I suppose it will stay a mere dream.
Yes? What can I do for you?
If there's nothing, I'll be on my way.
What's the matter? Have you lost your way?
! So it's you.
Are you interested in the book I was reading?
I'll lend you the book once I've finished it.
, welcome!
How nice of you to come again.
All who love learning are most welcome.
Is something the matter?
Are you in some trouble? I'd be glad to help.
Good morning. How do you do?
No, not at all.
I've just moved here, so I came to say hello.
I'm
note: Before the name; #452/#473 give the full stop.
After 'I'm '/'My name is ' + name. Variant ' is my name.' where the name starts the line with nothing before it.

en: Pleased to meet you.
note: Variant with a leading space where it follows #5477 on the same line (msg 325310).

en: That's wonderful work.
(He's a strange man, though.
Reading as he walks along...)
...Oh, I'd better be off to school soon.
I lose all track of time when I'm reading.

note: After the name ('{NAME}.') as the player's reply when asked his name; Variant 'you know.' for Robert (msgs 127659/127693/128000/128034), where it sits on its own line after #3391.

en: You must love reading, Matthew.
You've always got a book in your hand.
Oh yes, absolutely. I adore it.
Science, above all, captivates my heart.
Without scientific progress, mankind can't...
I-I'll hear about that some other time.
I'm terribly sorry, but I'm in a hurry...
Pondering science, picturing new technology.
And at times, chatting with a friend like you.
Oh, no, I'm the one who should apologize.
What kind of book are you reading?
Ah, good evening... Who might you be again?
Ah, I remember your face, but your name...
We always seem to meet when you're busy.
I'm reading a most fascinating book just now.
(He really does love reading, doesn't he?)
Good evening, Matthew.
I'm honored you remember. By the way...
<What have you been reading lately?>
